vo.text: A camera sensor does not see a finished photograph.
vo.speak: A camera sensor does not see a finished photograph.

vo.text: It measures light with millions of tiny photosites.
vo.speak: It measures light with millions of tiny photosites.

vo.text: Each photosite turns incoming light into an electrical signal.
vo.speak: Each photosite turns incoming light into an electrical signal.

vo.text: Most sensors place a color filter above each site.
vo.speak: Most sensors place a color filter above each site.

vo.text: The filters follow a mosaic of red, green, and blue.
vo.speak: The filters follow a mosaic of red, green, and blue.

vo.text: So each site records only one color plus brightness.
vo.speak: So each site records only one color plus brightness.

vo.text: The processor compares neighboring sites to estimate the missing colors.
vo.speak: The processor compares neighboring sites to estimate the missing colors.

vo.text: It also adjusts brightness and reduces noise before saving the image.
vo.speak: It also adjusts brightness and reduces noise before saving the image.

vo.text: A photo begins as many tiny light measurements, which the processor weaves into the colors you see.
vo.speak: A photo begins as many tiny light measurements, which the processor weaves into the colors you see.
